candidate.title: Bubble-Seq
candidate.scope: The Bubble-Seq row of the supplied Illumina poster: structure-based enrichment of restriction fragments containing replication initiation bubbles, followed by a schematic DNA sequencing-library interface. The matching collection page is headed Bubble-Seq and captions the same sequence as a schematic overview of Bubble-Seq. EC-seq above and NSCR below are separate neighboring assays, not alternatives of this card. The introductory yellow bubble highlight is unlabeled and is not treated as a chemical modification. This is schematic-level architecture, not the complete Mesner experimental protocol.

operations.label: Run gel
operations.description: Electrophoreses the embedded digest before plug recovery. The depicted route and reported trapping mechanism support retention of bubble-bearing DNA and relative depletion of freely migrating linear DNA; the latter fraction is not separately drawn.

operations.information_effect: Selects DNA molecules by their replication-bubble structure. Selection is enrichment, not proof that every retained fragment is an origin or that all origins are represented.

method_scopes.rationale: All six operations belong to the single explicitly labeled Bubble-Seq row. The collection heading, matching schematic labels, and reference 63 associate it with Mesner et al. (2013). Primary full text supports trapping circular bubble structures in agarose and sequencing DNA representing the selected restriction fragments; it used cloned origin libraries and EcoRI fragments. These implementation details clarify the representation, but do not turn the broad Add sequencing primers caption into a detailed cloning or adapter protocol. The collection prose additionally describes biotin tailing, sonication, and streptavidin capture; these operations are absent from the assigned schematic and are not imported into its route. Restriction-fragment representation limits localization to origin-containing intervals, and the primary paper reports losses near restriction sites and in very small fragments. The additional Mukhopadhyay et al. (2014) entry is recorded separately in pm_mukhopadhyay as listed_not_read/catalogue_citation with methods=[]. The collection listing and the matching bibliographic entry in Foulk b00105 are the inspected evidence; no source containing Mukhopadhyay's own article content or dedicated metadata record is supplied. The PaperMatch source identifies the supplied Foulk publication as the reference host only, and no workflow applicability is assigned to the cited Mukhopadhyay paper.
